purpose: One script for every provider so the owner can compare voice, lip sync, blinking, expression and head movement side by side. About 20-25 seconds per coach: a greeting, a question with a natural pause, a light laugh, and advice.

ava.voice_brief: Warm, confident American woman, late 20s; direct but kind; smiles while talking.
ava.text: Hi, I'm Ava. Okay, so tell me... what happened after you sent that first message? ... Ha, honestly, that's more common than you think. Here's what I'd do: keep the next message short, ask about something specific in their profile, and give them an easy way to answer.

ethan.voice_brief: Relaxed, friendly American man, early 30s; practical, a little playful.
ethan.text: Hey, I'm Ethan. So, you've got a date on Friday. Nice. ... Let me ask you something first: where are you meeting? ... Good choice. Pick one thing you're curious about, and let the conversation go from there. You don't need a script.

sofia.voice_brief: Warm, encouraging Mexican woman, late 20s; natural Latin American Spanish.
sofia.text: Hola, soy Sofía. A ver, cuéntame... ¿qué te contestó después de tu primer mensaje? ... Ja, tranquilo, eso le pasa a mucha gente. Mi consejo: escribe algo corto, pregunta por un detalle de su perfil y dale una forma fácil de responder.

diego.voice_brief: Calm, honest Mexican man, early 30s; natural Latin American Spanish.
diego.text: Hola, soy Diego. Entonces, ¿ya tienes la cita para el viernes? Qué bien. ... Primero dime: ¿dónde se van a ver? ... Buena elección. Piensa en una cosa que de verdad te dé curiosidad de esa persona, y deja que la plática fluya.

what_to_judge: Voice: does it sound like a real person (breathing, pauses, intonation, the small laugh)?
Lip sync: do lips match the actual sounds, at a natural speed?
Eyes: natural blink rate (about every 3-6 seconds), small eye movements, no staring.
Face and head: subtle smiles, eyebrows, slight head motion; no warping of the face.
Identity: is it still clearly the same approved face?
Listening: in the live demo, does the coach look like it is listening while you talk?
